ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.15:0.85; dominant low-intensity black pigmentation with scattered high-intensity white pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dispersed high-contrast white circular and linear blobs; higher concentration of high-intensity pixels in the distal regions of both lobes and along the trailing edges.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an internal angle of approximately 95 degrees and a vertical depth relative to the fluke span of ~12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular macro-serrations; left trailing edge displays 6 distinct peaks; right trailing edge displays 5 distinct peaks with pixel-amplitudes varying between 10-25 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the distal lobe segments transitioning to a concave sweep toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular white pixel clusters (5-15 pixel diameter) distributed across the right lobe surface and the mid-section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-mid region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface; distinct jagged notch located on the distal tip of the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: High-frequency white pixel noise from water spray partially occluding the right fluke lobe.
